token.description: Bearer token clients must send (Authorization: Bearer <token>). Required: with an empty token the server does not start. Use a long random string.

listen_host.description: Address the MCP/HTTP server listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless the agent runs on another host (the token then travels in plain HTTP).

listen_port.description: Port of the MCP/HTTP server (MCP endpoint: http://<host>:<port>/mcp)

allow_commands.description: Optional allowlist of command prefixes, exactly as a user types them incl. the prefix (e.g. gs体力, /rss list). EMPTY (default) = EVERY command may run, as any recent speaker incl. admins. Non-empty = only matches: 'x' allows 'x' and 'x <args>'; 'x*' also allows arguments glued on ('gs查询123').

deny_commands.description: Commands that are always refused, checked before allow_commands. Prefix match ignoring case and whitespace ('gs绑定' also blocks 'GS绑定uid123'); denying a registered AstrBot command also blocks its aliases and other wake prefixes. List bind/unbind, destructive and admin commands here.

extra_commands.description: Commands outside AstrBot's registry (e.g. GsCore) to show in list_commands, as 'command | description'. Denied ones are hidden; with a non-empty allow_commands they must also match it.

max_message_age_seconds.description: Refuse when the referenced message is older than this many seconds

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum run_command calls per minute across all callers (0 = unlimited)

platform_id.description: ID of the aiocqhttp platform instance to use. Empty = the first aiocqhttp platform.

self_id.description: Bot QQ number. Only needed when several OneBot accounts are connected to the same aiocqhttp platform; empty = use the only connection.
